subject: Real-time specs alignment and onboarding handshake
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@latticehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: integrations@latticehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: real-time output + toolcall alignment (Lattice -> Redwood)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Lattice is ready to start the feature enablement track for our real-time patient summarization flow. The high-level asks: streaming output for live transcripts, tool-calling to a medication-checking microservice, and a structured JSON summary (strict schema) that our downstream systems can ingest.

Goals and constraints from our side:
- Go-live target: 2027-06-20 (pilot at 10% traffic)
- Latency SLO: 250ms median token latency for short requests (<= 256 tokens)
- Structured schema must validate against our ingestion pipeline; any mismatch will trigger a fail in QA
- No PHI should persist in hosted logs; we will need guidance on Private deployment options if required

What we can share today: a small set of example payloads (attached: patient_payload_examples.json) and a short CSV of endpoint mappings in the integrations inbox.

Asks for Redwood:
1) A compact onboarding checklist with phase gates and acceptance tests (smoke, schema validation, toolcall replay).
2) A recommended approach for streaming vs. batch for our traffic pattern (spiky inbound clusters).
3) A quick sim harness or test endpoint we can push example requests to, so our devs can validate responses and schema enforcement.

Could we do an engineering sync next week (Wed/Thu) to walk through the schema and the toolcall contract? We can send our security folks if needed for the data-retention conversation.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
Lattice Health

--
Attachment: patient_payload_examples.json (6KB)
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily@latticehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: real-time output + toolcall alignment (Lattice -> Redwood)

Emily —

Appreciate the details and the sample payloads. Short reply with next steps:

1) I attached a one-page onboarding checklist (see Drive link below) that breaks the work into 3 phases: discovery, staging validation, pilot rollout. Phase gates include the streaming smoke test, toolcall replay (deterministic), and schema gating with a JSON Schema validator.
2) For your latency SLO we recommend using our low-latency streaming path with small batching (auto-batching disabled for these flows) and a dedicated route pinned to a verified model. We can run a baseline test and share profiling metrics.
3) We have a test harness option — we will provide temporary test endpoints that accept your example payloads and return instrumented responses; we'll hand you a simple curl + node example to run.

Proposed times for an engineering sync:
- Wed 2027-06-02 13:00 PDT
- Thu 2027-06-03 09:00 PDT

Monica, Camila — can you own preparing the schema validator (+ mapping guide) and the mock harness instructions?

Emily — forwarding a Drive folder and a draft mapping (attached as schema-mapping-v0.json). Also linking our onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLatticeOnboard

Quick note: regarding logs and PHI — if Lattice opts for Private deployment we can provide a control plane inside your VPC and full KMS-based encryption; happy to loop in security during the next call.

Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: schema-mapping-v0.json (3KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Lattice onboarding plan (draft)

Alex / Camila / Tessa —

Draft plan to share on the call with Lattice. I'm pasting the high-level phases and acceptance tests so we have alignment before we speak with their engineers. Please review and add any gaps.

Phase 0 — Discovery (this week)- Deliverables: mapped sample payloads, security checklist, endpoints inventory.

Phase 1 — Staging validation (2 weeks)- Deliverables: test endpoint (mock harness), schema-mapping JSON Schema v1, toolcall contract (OpenAPI stub), runbook for simulated failures.- Acceptance tests:
  * Streaming smoke: send 100 short transcripts via streaming API; expect valid structured JSON for 98/100 and median token latency < 300ms.
  * Toolcall replay: replay 50 recorded events to the medication-checker tool; all calls must return within 400ms and be idempotent.
  * Schema gate: run the JSON Schema validator; any schema violations must be triaged and fixed before pilot.

Phase 2 — Pilot (10%)- Rollout mechanics: canary route to dedicated pool, automatic fallback to a smaller model if latency spikes, and real-time metrics visible in the console.

Phase 3 — Production cutoff and cutover checklist- Rolling 48h monitor, on-call coverage, rollback playbook.

Attachments to include for the call:
- mock-harness-instructions.txt (how to invoke our test endpoint + example curl requests)
- schema-mapping-v0.json (already drafted; will iterate live)

Notes / questions for Lattice:
- Do they require Private deployment for data residency? If yes, we need their security contact this week.
- Confirm the exact set of fields required in the final structured summary (we need field-level types to draft strict schema).

Camila: can you prepare the OpenAPI stub for the medication-checker toolcall? Tessa: will you prepare a quick run of the streaming path so we can show the latency profile in the call?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: mock-harness-instructions.txt (2KB)
From: Jason Lin <jason@latticehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@latticehealth.com>, integrations@latticehealth.com
Date: 2027-06-02T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: real-time output + toolcall alignment (Lattice -> Redwood)

Alex / Monica —

Thanks — the plan looks good. We confirmed the Wed 6/2 13:00 PDT slot and our engineering lead (Chris) will join; attaching a short set of example JSON documents that reflect the final fields we expect (see patient_payload_examples.json).

Bandwidth notes: our priority is schema correctness over small token latency variance during the pilot. We can accept a modest increase in median latency if it avoids schema drift. That said, we still want streaming behavior for incremental tokens as transcripts come in.

Two asks before the sync:
- Please confirm the format of function/toolcall responses (OpenAPI stub is fine) and whether toolcalls are synchronous or can be performed asynchronously with an event callback.
- Share any rate limits or quotas we should account for while running the staging tests (so we don't hit throttling during smoke tests).

We'll bring our security lead to the next meeting if Private deployment looks necessary from the compliance side.

See you Wednesday.

Jason Lin
CTO, Lattice Health
jason@latticehealth.com
